mainEntity.name: How long does gate repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of gate repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple repairs like sensor adjustments or minor component replacements can often be completed within a few hours. More complex repairs, such as motor replacement or extensive structural work, might take a full day or require multiple visits, especially if custom parts need to be ordered. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring quality workmanship.
